title: Assess Systems the Way You Build Them

why.description: Why now: AI-driven attacks go broad, so broad, repeatable assessment becomes a requirement for building systems.

isnt.description: What this isn’t: a pentest, or AI code review on its own.

history.description: How we got here: locks and tiger teams, then systems too big to get your arms around, so broad assessment went niche.

philosophy.description: Security as an emergent property: one -ility among many, traded off against the others.

idea.description: We already build software with AI and humans in the loop, so assess it the same way.

stages.description: The seven stages of the program, with the human gates.

practice.description: Running it for real: the loop, an example, failure modes, the payoff, and where to start.
